_: Shipyard's keyboard shortcuts, read by the webview (lib/shortcuts.ts: the handlers, the Keyboard shortcuts sheet, Settings → Shortcuts) and by the Mac app's menu bar (src-tauri/src/lib.rs). group is the menu an item is in; accel, when set, puts it there with that accelerator, so macOS cannot take the key first. count makes items 1..count, with {n} in label and accel. code, when set, is the e.code the key handler matches the key by (its place, not its character): keys shows a US keyboard's key, and the lists show the key in that place on the layout in use (lib/key-layout.ts). Never give ⌘C, ⌘V, ⌘A or ⌘F an accelerator: focused terminals and text need them.
